title: Arbitrary-order structure-preserving discretizations for geometric curvature flows
summary: Geometric flows, where an immersed manifold evolves in time according to its own geometry, exhibit important structural properties. For example, surface diffusion dissipates surface area while conserving volume; it is desirable to preserve these properties on discretization. This has motivated a substantial body of research on structure-preserving discretizations for these flows, albeit at low order in time.
